Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all distinct molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123859. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by document ChEMBL ID, and to compound_structures on molregno to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Return only rows where canonical SMILES is present. Order results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
